text:
Nina Flores: Heads-up: BrightLeaf wants a multi-region staged rollout (EU primary, APAC next) for their private cluster. They require a sticky routing guarantee per-tenant and a shadow/mirror path to validate quality before cutover. Also asked for a clear user-visible header when degraded. Need a concrete rollout + failover diagram.
Marco Li: Suggestion: start with shadow-mirror for 48h (all requests duplicated, no impact) + sampling metrics. Then do sticky canary with 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% over ~5 days. Use a cookie/header to ensure session stickiness: X-RW-Sticky: tenant=brightleaf.
Ellen Park: Agree on stickiness. Add a delayed cutover step: route 10% for new sessions only for 24h before routing existing session traffic. That reduces churn on KV caches.
Vikram Shah: Fallback ladder we should implement: (A) route to regional small-quant model variant, (B) enable prefix-cache-only mode (serve from cache if hit), (C) switch to reduced-output-mode (truncate completions at 200 tokens + disable streaming), (D) circuit-break to previous stable if unresolved. Each step should be reversible and audited.
Nina Flores: Good ladder. BrightLeaf also asked for explicit consumer-facing header when any fallback active: `X-RW-Degraded: true;reason=cache-fallback`. Add doc blurb for what each state means.
Marco Li: Telemetry gates: fail if p95 latency increases >40% vs baseline for 10m, OR 5xx rate > 0.8% for 5m, OR live-quality proxy (semantic-similarity) drops >6% over a 1h window. Also gate on token-cost per session +20% sustained for 30m.
Ellen Park: For quality measurement, run semantic-similarity metric (embedding cosine) on sampled pairs and queue 75 sessions for human review (per ramp step). We'll need a small human-review UI. QA-bot: can we retroactively flag samples?
qa-bot: qa-bot: Yes - human-review queue created when canary=3% and above. Will attach session ids to the queue.
Vikram Shah: Operational knobs: add a region-affinity param to the routing table, and a `fanout=false` flag for shadowing to avoid double billing. For shutters, implement `shutter_rate` to throttle percent of requests forwarded to BrightLeaf.
Nina Flores: Naming: feature flag `tenant:brightleaf:rollout_state`. States: `shadow`, `canary`, `ramped`, `degraded`, `rollback`. All transitions write to audit log with user and timestamp.
Marco Li: Abort policy: if any kill condition fires and persists for 12 minutes despite auto-fallback steps A->C, we auto-rollback and open an incident. If it resolves within 12 minutes by an auto-fix, we hold and re-evaluate.
Ellen Park: Add a soft-notify to the customer when we enter `degraded` with the header and an admin email + runbook link. Add a billing note: if we serve on fallback small model, we bill at reduced rate per contract.
Vikram Shah: A/B proposal: during the `canary` phase, run an A/B where 10% of canary traffic uses quantized model B to validate quality delta in production. Capture quality proxies and cost delta.
Nina Flores: Owners: Product = Nina (spec + customer comms), Runtime = Marco (routing, shutters, sticky), Eng-ML = Ellen (quality metrics + review), SRE = Vikram (runbook + rollback automation), Solutions = Priya (customer handoff).
Marco Li: Checklist: flag schema, routing-affinity support, shadowing toggle (billing-safe), telemetry dashboard (p95, 5xx, cost/session, fallback-rate, quality-proxy), human-review queue, customer docs, runbook with kill-criteria, postmortem template. Schedule: start infra work 2026-03-28, shadowing to BrightLeaf 2026-04-06, soft cutover 2026-04-12.
qa-bot: qa-bot: Preflight: synthetic smoke of 60 prompts + regression check required before canary.
Vikram Shah: Implementation notes: add `X-RW-Degrade-Mode` in responses detailing active fallback steps. Keep `grace_inflight_ms=2000` so in-flight requests finish. Reserve a grace-token bucket of 250 rps for brightleaf to avoid abrupt drops.
Marco Li: Ops API example for shutters: `POST /flags/tenant/brightleaf/shutter {"pct": 20, "reason": "latency_spike"}`. Will add RBAC so only SRE+product can run forced rollback.
Nina Flores: Customer-facing note: if we degrade, some completions may be shorter or less creative; we'll mark endpoints in Console as `DEGRADED`. Tom from solutions will draft SLA blurb.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Flag `tenant:brightleaf:rollout_state` created in staging.
Ellen Park: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the semantic-similarity probe harness and pick 300 evaluation prompts. Marco/Vikram - please instrument fallback_count and fallback_latency histogram.
Vikram Shah: Will do. Also adding an alert that surfaces when fallback_rate > 2% for > 5m.
Nina Flores: Final question: do we allow cross-region failover (route EU -> US) as last resort? BrightLeaf explicitly asked to avoid US routing for compliance. So cross-region failover is OFF. Document that as a hard constraint.
Marco Li: Noted. We'll keep hard region restriction in the routing policy.
Nina Flores: Great. I'll convert this into a short spec doc and assign tasks. Schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow to finalize dates. Thanks team.
